Tuza | Product Engineer & AI Engineer | Shoreditch, London | Onsite 3 days/week | Candidates must be based in UK to apply | Visa sponsorship available

We build AI agents for banks, automating the manual work in sales, onboarding and activation. Raised $7m from Northzone, Connect Ventures and TriplePoint. Working with Worldpay, Barclaycard and NatWest. Team of 12.

Hiring two roles:

- Product Engineer: full-stack features (React, Node.js, TypeScript), API and cloud architecture (AWS) for agent workloads. 4+ years' experience.

- AI Engineer: multi-agent workflows (Temporal/LangChain), evals, fail-safes and audit trails for banking tasks. 4+ years' experience, strong Python.

Both roles spend time inside partner banks, working directly with the teams using the product. Competitive salary, equity, meaningful benefits and an epic team.

https://www.tuza.ai/careers
